Kento Alpha 0.6, build 1000

In this build

  • On a Mac signed in to the studio's Tailscale network, Kento activates on its own: no letter or code needed. The seat is in your name, lasts 14 days and renews each time Kento checks in on the network. Kento > Activate Kento... says so.
  • Reads and Writes keep their paths as the comp has them and translate them as they read and write: a comp from Windows or Linux reads its footage on the Mac, and saves with its own paths. A path map now names one place on each kind of machine (Z:/kura=/Volumes/Autonomy/kura=/media/Autonomy/kura).
  • Paths relative to the comp (plates/sh010.####.exr) read from the comp's folder; a .nk's relative form opens relative and is written back the same way.
  • Nagi 1.4.7: reflections sliding over moving car paint are no longer read as noise and wiped.

Not yet

  • Cameras and geometry still translate their paths one way, as a comp opens.
  • The path maps as a table with Mac, Windows and Linux columns; the noise scopes; re-bake as you shape.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 985

In this build

  • A motion baked into keys shows its shaping curves in the Curve Editor at once, with the knob's keys from before it: the curve list and the dope strip now follow every change to the comp, undo too, not only a change of selection.
  • About Kento moves when you drag it anywhere on its background.
  • The manual has four new figures: Settings > General and Node Graph, the History window, and a baked motion being shaped.

Not yet

  • Re-bake as you shape, without the click; Kento's own colour picker.
  • Paths written back for Windows and Linux on save, and relative paths.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 979

In this build

  • Every motion keeps its shaping curves when baked, Random per frame and Flicker too: the chip stays on the curve, Shape in the Curve Editor shows them beside the keys, and Re-bake writes the keys again from them.
  • The middle mouse button pans the Curve Editor, whether or not keys are selected (it used to move them).

Not yet

  • Curves baked before build 974 have no recipe to shape: bake them again from their keys.
  • Re-bake as you shape, without the click; Kento's own colour picker.
  • Paths written back for Windows and Linux on save, and relative paths.
